answer: The bridge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the jetty. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The walnut of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, expired if not renewed by fresh work, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
